title: Not as advertised and poorly maintained.
negative_text: Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations. There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion. Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided. On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag. There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates. Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning. There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

negative_text: This place used to be good about five years ago, but unfortunately, the standard has deteriorated dramatically. It seems they have lowered their prices and opened the doors to just about anyone, and the overall environment has suffered as a result. The place is now extremely dirty and messy, with some residents leaving filthy, smelly clothes scattered around their rooms. There are people struggling with drug and alcohol problems, disruptive behaviour, and a general lack of consideration for others. Many appear to be staying long-term rather than being ordinary travellers or holidaymakers. The meals are incredibly basic and poor quality. Dinner is so cheap and unappealing that it feels more like a charity meal than something you'd expect from paid accommodation. To be fair, the Sydney staff do try to do a good job, and I acknowledge their efforts. However, the management appears to have little control over the standard of residents or the behaviour occurring on the premises. I've witnessed some extraordinary things, including someone running a power cord out of a window to charge an electric car parked in the driveway. Customer service is another major problem. The overseas customer service team can sometimes be helpful, but too often, instead of taking responsibility and resolving a complaint, they look for excuses and try to shift the blame back onto the customer. Questions such as why an issue wasn't reported earlier seem to take priority over actually addressing the problem. Management has apparently sent warnings about behaviour such as smoking drugs in rooms and urinating in bottles, yet the fact that such warnings are necessary tells you something about the environment. It's disappointing because this place had a good reputation years ago. The Sydney staff deserve credit for trying, but the overall management, cleanliness, resident standards, food quality and customer service have deteriorated significantly.

title: Que sea barato no implica que su mantenimiento sea deficiente.
positive_text: Si estás valorando este hostel en tu estancia en Sydney posiblemente será por su ubicación y porque es de los que incluye desayuno y cena en el precio. Posiblemente ambos puntos son sus claras ventajas para decidirse frente a otros, aunque con matices. Respecto a la ubicación, personalmente creo que es su punto fuerte. Bien conectado a la estación central de tren, está en un punto que andando puedes llegar a Circular Quay en apenas 30-40 minutos andando a un ritmo normal. Estás en un punto que si te decides por ir a The Rocks, o a la zona de Chinatown, también está a menos de 30 minutos andando, por lo que estás prácticamente en el centro de todo. Si además planeas acercarte a Bondi Beach desde aquí, hay línea de autobús y en menos de 1h de trayecto estás allí con un solo transbordo. Otro de sus puntos positivos, en mi caso debo destacar las habitaciones. Literas rígidas y cómodas que no se mueven en absoluto (si has ido a otros hostel sabes de lo que hablo). Colchones decentes por el precio a pagar y habitación relativamente correcta en cuanto a espacio (al menos en las habitaciones de 6 personas). Por último, la parte del desayuno y cena que incluyen en el precio. Desde luego que es una ventaja frente a otras opciones de hostel que no incluyen nada. Desayuno básico que se sirve de 7:30am a 9am, incluye zumo, leche, té/café, cereales y pan de molde con diferentes mermeladas, mantequilla y crema de cacahuete. Eso es todo. Simple y básico. Y lo mismo ocurre en la cena. Horario de 18:30pm a 19:45pm, suelen ser platos básicos donde no podemos destacar que sean las mejores opciones nutritivamente hablando. Pasta algunos días, pollo con puré de patata otros, o arroz con carne picada. No esperes la mejor cena posible, de hecho da más sensación de comedor social que de hostel.
negative_text: Soy crítico porque en mis últimos 5 meses viajando he estado en muchos hostel y entiendo que si busco las opciones más económicas, renuncio a ciertas comodidades que otros más caros si me ofrecen (como más cantidad de baños, cocinas más grandes y más equipadas, zonas comunes de mejor calidad y más amplias, etc). Lo que no está bien es la falta de mantenimiento general del lugar. Es un hostel viejo si nos centramos en sus comodidades, y salvo las habitaciones que a mi parecer estaban en buen estado general, el resto fue bastante decepcionante. La mayoría de baños estaban viejos y no funcionaban como deberían. Ya sea un grifo roto, una ducha sin mucha presión de agua u otro con el suelo siempre con agua. Se notaba una falta de mantenimiento del lugar. Por no decir que en general estaban sucios. Paredes de las duchas por ejemplo que dudo se hayan limpiado en los últimos meses, papeleras llenas muchas ocasiones, y en definitiva, sensación de abandono. Por supuesto, entiendo que pagar un precio reducido por una noche en Sydney con desayuno y cena incluido, tienes que renunciar a cierto confort en tu estancia. Pero eso no implica llegar a un lugar con poco mantenimiento y con zonas sucias en general.

Não gosto de fazer avaliações negativas pois não quero prejudicar ninguém, mas também não posso deixar outras pessoas serem enganadas como fui. They had overbooked, had zero beds left, and sent her to Darling Harbour location. She had to accept a room with males because when she requested a discount for the trouble, she was told you can stay at the original "hotel" (that was overbooked) or forfeit your payment because they dont offer refunds. THIRD RED FLAG, We had to get our bedding changed before we could even sit down after a 9 hour drive. There was hair and stains on the linen. NONE of the beds had been changed before our arrival. The listing says it is a HOTEL. It is barely a hostel. We booked a Private Room with shared toilet/shower, which reads as shared between the 4 people in the room. It is communal showers and toilets in the middle of the building. The room has an air-conditioner but the staff have the remote, for reasons unknown. We had to call and ask them to send the staff member to change the temperature because the AC was set to fan only. When they arrived, they acted like they couldnt work out the remote. We had to ask for the remote and change the settings ourselves The showers and toilets stank and were just nasty. Do yourself a favour and steer well clear of Azzurro Hotel. The place is a joke.

There's more but it's easier to just say go find a better hostel than this. Especially one that has staff actually in the building to help you.

title: I hated my stay here, do yourself a favour and book a YHA instead (the price isn't much different)
negative_text: I booked a 2 night stay and left after 1 night. 1) The photos look good and it has an overall good rating calls itself a “Pod Hotel”- do not be fooled! Price attractive includes breakfast and dinner, honestly I think you're better off booking into a lovely YHA and getting some bread or cereal yourself! My room wasn’t anything like the photos. 2) No staff at reception, communicate though a monitor screen. The luggage storage is an open room, not secure at all. Communal areas were smelly and dirty. 4) Location inconvenient getting to and from the hostel and quite a sketchy area 6) I had a 4 bed dorm to myself as no one else had booked but it was SO depressing in there. The room smelt of damp and it looked like there was mould on the curtains . I woke up with a chesty cough (also cold in there) 7) The aircon was in the room set to 23 degrees, I asked staff at around 9pm and they said there should be a remote in the room, there wasn’t so they said they’ll send someone. They 2 hours later (around 11pm) and I asked them to switch airon off he refused saying it would get too hot. It was Autumn. He said to call if too cold, so I did they said someone will come. They came just before 1AM to switch it off. I was sleeping. 8) I did not want to stay another night so I left in the morning and was refused a refund for the night I wasn’t staying. I gave numerous opportunities to resolve this but I think it’s important to leave an honest review. I’ve stayed in many hostels internationally and I will take bad reviews with a pinch of salt if photos and rating seems good, but I think this is the worst I’ve stayed in. The photos are very misleading, it looks nice on the photos but the reality is far from it. The vibe in terms of décor, smell, cleanliness and even other people there is SO depressing. I was so much happier when I went to a YHA instead. 9) Bathrooms are small, so get soaked and gross and not enough of them. Limited characters so had to cut text out.The end.

negative_text: Not very good. Surprised at the overall quite high ratings. The pictures were clearly taken when renovations were new and everything was crisp and nice. Now it's generally pretty run down and grotty. Everything's a little bit dirty, especially the bathrooms which definitely need a deep clean. Also some of the bathrooms have issues like broken showers. There is minimal storage options in the bedroom, some hooks and more/bigger cupboards would've been nice. The bunk bed itself was nice enough to sleep in but limited beside fixtures (ie no shelf or fixed light) make it less than ideal. Reception is entirely remote. The online check-in wasn't working when I arrived and was left waiting for someone to respond to my messages. Especially difficult when you've just arrived in the country and don't have proper phone/internet access yet. Also the need to upload signed pdf forms and ID to stay after payment and confirmation has come through its a nuisance. All in all I felt like I'd walked into a poor house rather than a "hotel" as they call themselves. I understand it is cheap accommodation but don't get your hopes up. I was definitely disappointed and won't be staying here again except as a last resort.
